title: Labcorp to Speak at the UBS Global Healthcare Conference
summary: BURLINGTON, N.C., Nov. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Labcorp (NYSE: LH), a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services, announced today that Chief Financial Officer Julia Wang will speak at the UBS Global Healthcare Conference on November 10 at 8:45 a.m. ET.
body_markdown:
BURLINGTON, N.C.


, Nov. 4, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Labcorp](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813601-1&h=3534304218&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.labcorp.com%2F&a=Labcorp) (NYSE: LH), a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services, announced today that Chief Financial Officer Julia Wang will speak at the UBS Global Healthcare Conference on November 10 at 8:45 a.m. ET.


A live audio webcast of the fireside chat will be available via the Labcorp Investor Relations website at[ir.labcorp.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813601-1&h=1115041337&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4058904-1%26h%3D1671290528%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fir.labcorp.com%252F%26a%3Dir.Labcorp.com&a=ir.labcorp.com) and archived for replay for 180 days following the event.


**About Labcorp**
Labcorp (NYSE: LH) is a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services that helps doctors, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, researchers and patients make clear and confident decisions. We provide insights and advance science to improve health and improve lives through our unparalleled diagnostics and drug development laboratory capabilities. The company's nearly 71,000 employees serve clients in approximately 100 countries, provided support for more than 85% of the new drugs and therapeutic products approved by the FDA in 2025 and performed more than 750 million tests for patients around the world.
